title: Law 4.2 Probe: Swapped Depth Asymmetry (Shallow G vs Deep 16L Critic)
intuition: Inverts depth asymmetry onto the critic: pairs a shallow 3-layer MLP generator with a deep 16-layer skip-free LeakyReLU critic (fourier=0) on an 8-mode 2D ring. Tests whether spectral conditioning rescues deep critics as well as deep generators.
failure_mode: Without Law 4.2 spectral conditioning on D, the 16-layer critic's input Jacobian contracts to ~5e-7, leaving one-sided upper slope caps inactive and starving the generator of any useful force field.
protocol_notes: Four Laws Adherence diagnostic probe (800 updates, 8-mode ring R=2.5, valley_fraction <= 0.05).
